extraction.Name: Josephine DuBrey Whitford
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: we traded it for mother peice of land
extraction.Buyer: Bill Tackett assumed the mortgage on the first piece and gave us $1200 to boot on the piece we now own; the $1200 was in cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: It was mortgaged to the attorneys. A fraud deal was pulled over on us, George Dodson's agent showed us one piece of land and deeded us another, and we took it to court and won tha lanc our own land back. Then we finally traded for a piece in Todd County, which was satisfactory. The mortgage was for $1,000.00
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered by mother, who got it from boss farmer; allotment north of Winner; did not sign a receipt for it; did not make application for the patent; not in good health; four children dependent upon her; supported by husband; superintendent E. E. McKean noted on document; questionnaire subscribed and sworn June 19, 1929
